set.body:
Found in the review of the identity fix 3d513f14 (bd-01M3SC5BYS29CR1TVS2JCVZ3Y8, Fray #153).

design/hrf/KernelBasis.scala:57-59: KernelBasisProvenance.canonical ('kernel-basis/v1') interpolates Doubles (lo, hi, horizon, step, tolerance) via s"...". Scala.js prints 24 where the JVM prints 24.0. The string flows into ConditionProfileProvenance.basis (fit/.../ConditionProfileFit.scala:66), so PHRF condition-fit provenance differs across platforms.

Fix: encode the numbers with doubleToLongBits in the same style as HrfIdentity, bump to kernel-basis/v2, and add a shared JVM+JS literal golden. Also consider a shared bits helper instead of inline doubleToLongBits across the design module.
set.title: KernelBasisProvenance.canonical interpolates Doubles (JVM/JS provenance drift)
